headline: TECK-BACKED ABRASILVER FINDS NEW PORPHYRY AT YARETAS SUR — 42m AT 1.03% COPPER PLUS 748m AT 0.69% Cu AT LA COIPITA, SAN JUAN
source_name: Junior Mining Network / AbraSilver Resource Corp. (TSX: ABRA)
snippet: AbraSilver Resource Corp. (TSX: ABRA) reported 2026 drill results on June 15 from its La Coipita copper-gold-molybdenum project in San Juan Province, Argentina — a program fully funded and operated by Teck Resources Limited under an earn-in agreement — with the headline hole DDH-LC26-011 returning 748 metres averaging 0.69% copper, 0.06 g/t gold, and 142 ppm molybdenum from the Yaretas target. More significantly, hole DDH-LC26-012 intersected a brand new discovery at the Yaretas Sur target 1.9 km south, returning 42 metres at 1.03% copper, 0.63 g/t gold, and 41 g/t silver from 264 metres depth — shallower, higher-grade, and in an area with no prior drilling that leaves mineralisation open in all directions. Teck has now invested approximately US$23 million across 11,270 metres of drilling at La Coipita under the earn-in structure, and the Yaretas Sur discovery adds a second independent centre to a porphyry copper system that is beginning to outline the footprint of a district-scale deposit. For retail copper investors, the combination of 748 metres of continuous 0.69% copper at Yaretas and a new shallower high-grade centre at Yaretas Sur 2 km away is the structural discovery signal that precedes resource delineation drilling in large porphyry systems — and in a province whose copper-gold-molybdenum porphyry belt has produced several world-class mines.

headline: SILVERCORP YING MINE: +50% RESERVE TONNES, 106 MOZ SILVER LOCKED IN — 17-YEAR MINE LIFE CONFIRMS CHINA'S PREMIER PRIMARY SILVER PRODUCER
source_name: PR Newswire / Silvercorp Metals Inc. (TSX/NYSE: SVM)
snippet: Silvercorp Metals Inc. (TSX/NYSE: SVM) announced a 50% increase in mineral reserve tonnes and a 20% increase in contained silver ounces for the Ying Mining District in Henan Province, China, based on an updated NI 43-101 Technical Report with an effective date of December 31, 2025. Proven and Probable reserves now stand at 19 million tonnes grading 174 g/t silver, containing 106 million ounces of silver, 107,000 ounces of gold, 472,000 tonnes of lead, and 150,000 tonnes of zinc — supporting a 17-year mine life across seven underground mines and the newly commencing KP underground operation. The reserve growth was achieved using a higher silver price assumption of $28/oz (versus $21/oz in 2024), reflecting the structural repricing of silver in the 2024-2026 bull market cycle, and was made possible by over three years of intensive exploration drilling that converted Mineral Resources into Reserves across seven different mine complexes. The stock rose 14.8% on the reserve announcement — the single largest single-day move for SVM since 2021 — reflecting the market's recognition that 106 million ounces of silver in a 17-year mine plan at an operating mine with existing processing infrastructure and a 174 g/t grade profile represents one of the highest-quality silver reserve updates announced by any TSX-listed company in the current silver bull market cycle.

headline: GOLD AT $4,144 ENTERS WEEK'S BIGGEST MACRO TEST — PMI MONDAY, GDP+PCE THURSDAY, UMICH FRIDAY WILL DECIDE IF $4,000 FLOOR HOLDS
snippet: Gold enters the week of June 22-26 at approximately $4,144 per ounce, tracking a third consecutive weekly decline after the Federal Reserve's June 16-17 FOMC meeting revealed nine of nineteen committee members now project at least one rate hike before year-end — pushing the US dollar to a one-year high and suppressing non-yielding precious metals. Silver sits near $64.71. The week's calendar is the most data-intensive of the summer: US Manufacturing and Services PMI for June prints Monday June 23, providing the first read on whether the US economy is strong enough to justify the hawkish dot-plot; Q1 GDP second revision and Core PCE inflation arrive together Thursday June 25; and the University of Michigan's final June consumer inflation expectations print Friday June 26, the number the Fed watches most closely for inflation-expectations anchoring. A softer-than-expected PMI or cooling inflation expectations would reduce the probability of a July rate hike and remove the primary headwind that has pushed gold from the $4,300 recovery high reached June 17 to the current $4,144. Goldman Sachs cut its year-end gold target to $4,900 (from $5,400) on June 19, while the World Gold Council's June survey found a record 45% of central banks plan to add gold reserves in the next 12 months — setting up this week's macro data as the clearest near-term signal for whether gold's correction extends toward the $4,000-$4,050 support level or stabilises ahead of the seasonal mid-July recovery window.

headline: HAWKISH FED + SOFTENING PHYSICAL PREMIUMS = GOLD'S MOST VULNERABLE WEEK SINCE JANUARY — KITCO: INSTITUTIONAL SELLING STILL LEADING
snippet: Kitco's June 19 PM Report documented a rare convergence of bearish technical conditions for gold: the Federal Reserve's hawkish pivot (38.5% probability of a July rate hike, 51.7% for September) is weighing on paper-market positioning while simultaneously physical gold premiums — a key indicator of end-consumer demand strength — softened in Asian trading following the FOMC meeting, removing the physical demand support that had cushioned gold's prior corrections in 2026. Gold traded at approximately $4,154.70 as US markets closed June 19, with spot silver at $64.71 — both reflecting the dollar's climb to its highest level since May 2025. Kitco's market analysts noted that the current setup differs from prior 2026 corrections where physical buyers consistently absorbed institutional liquidation above the $4,000-$4,100 level: the softening of Asian physical premiums post-FOMC suggests the price correction is now moving fast enough to create temporary hesitation among the physical buyers who have provided the structural floor in previous pullbacks. For retail investors in TSXV gold and silver equities, the softening physical premium signal is the most specific bearish data point from the post-FOMC correction — and the one to watch for reversal when this week's macro data (PMI Monday, GDP+PCE Thursday) begins to clarify whether the Fed's hawkish dot-plot is consistent with actual economic conditions.

headline: CPM GROUP: THIS IS NOT HOW BULL MARKETS END — BUY GOLD AND SILVER WHILE INSTITUTIONS STEP BACK
snippet: CPM Group's June 18 Kitco commentary — titled 'Buying Gold and Silver When Others Are Not' — presents the structural contrarian case for why the post-FOMC correction in gold and silver represents a strategic buying opportunity rather than a trend change, distinguishing between the cyclical rate-sensitive positioning that is driving current institutional selling and the secular demand dynamics that have driven the 2024-2026 bull market. CPM's research identifies the current period as exhibiting the same behavioral pattern that has historically preceded the strongest phases of commodity bull markets: institutional momentum sellers exit positions based on macro signals (Federal Reserve hawkishness, dollar strength) while fundamental buyers — central banks, industrial consumers, physical accumulators — continue purchasing at the lower prices the institutional exit creates. CPM notes that the current correction has not produced the demand destruction signals that mark secular bull market tops: central banks continue buying on schedule, silver industrial demand from solar, EV, and semiconductor sectors continues to grow, and the gold-silver ratio's expansion to 64:1 is historically consistent with accumulation opportunities rather than bear market initiations. For retail investors in junior mining equities, CPM's framework provides specific guidance: the difference between a temporary institutional correction and a secular reversal is measured by whether fundamental buyers fill the gap — and the evidence through mid-June 2026 is that they are.

headline: K2 GOLD CONFIRMS DISTRICT-SCALE GOLD-SILVER EPITHERMAL AT Si2 NEVADA — 5 TARGETS, 3,871m DEFINE A LARGE FERTILE SYSTEM
snippet: K2 Gold Corporation (TSXV: KTO) released June 18 assay results from its 2026 reverse-circulation drill program at the Si2 Gold Project in Esmeralda County, Nevada, with 3,871 metres drilled across eight holes targeting five widely separated priority areas (AOI1, AOI3, AOI4, AOI5, and AOI6). All holes intersected extensive low-sulphidation epithermal alteration characterised by silica flooding, adularia, and quartz vein networks — the mineralisation fingerprint of large productive epithermal gold-silver systems — confirming the presence of a large, fertile hydrothermal system across the full extent of the drilled area. The drill program returned both broad intervals of disseminated gold mineralisation and discrete high-grade epithermal quartz veins with the capacity to carry economically significant grades at depth — the two-track geometry (bulk tonnage disseminated + high-grade veins) that characterises Nevada's most prolific epithermal gold districts including the Carlin Trend and the Walker Lane belt in which Si2 is located. For retail investors tracking TSXV-listed gold explorers in the US Great Basin, K2 Gold's confirmation of a district-scale fertile epithermal system at Si2 across five independent targets within a single drill program is the geological result that justifies advancing from grassroots to systematic resource delineation — and the next program's geometry will be determined by the current batch of assay data.

headline: CASSIAR GOLD OPENS CAMP, LAUNCHES 10,000m AT TAURUS DEPOSIT — FULLY FUNDED BC GOLD SEASON TARGETS RESOURCE EXPANSION AND INFILL
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Cassiar Gold Corp. (TSXV: GLDC)
snippet: Cassiar Gold Corp. (TSXV: GLDC) announced on June 18, 2026 the commencement of Phase 1 of its 2026 diamond drill program at the Taurus Deposit within the Cassiar North project area in northern British Columbia, with the exploration camp opened and drilling underway targeting 10,000 metres of infill and resource expansion drilling. The Taurus Deposit is the primary resource development target at the Cassiar North project — an advanced gold exploration project in a historically productive mining camp that has produced several million ounces from high-grade gold veins over the past century. The 2026 Phase 1 program targets both extensions of known mineralisation beyond the current resource block model and infill drilling gaps to improve resource classification confidence — the dual objective of simultaneously building resource ounces and converting Inferred to Indicated that is required before any pre-feasibility study can be commissioned. Cassiar Gold's 2026 program is fully funded, ensuring the complete 10,000-metre Phase 1 campaign can be executed without capital market uncertainty affecting the drill schedule — a meaningful operational differentiator in the junior gold sector where underfunded exploration programs frequently miss their target drill footage. For retail investors tracking TSXV gold developers in BC, the combination of an established historical resource at Taurus, a fully funded 10,000-metre program, and a northern BC geological setting comparable to Golden Bear and Snip offers a structured value creation pathway at the current $4,100+ gold price.

headline: GOLDGROUP FIRES UP 24,000m AT SAN FRANCISCO, SONORA — 1.2 MOZ AU RESOURCE TARGETS MEXICO GOLD PRODUCTION RESTART BY YEAR-END 2026
snippet: Goldgroup Mining Inc. (TSXV: GGA) announced June 18, 2026 the commencement of a 24,000-metre diamond core drilling program at its 100%-owned San Francisco Gold Project in Sonora, Mexico — the first systematic drilling program at the project in many years and the key technical milestone required before a planned gold production restart targeted for end-2026 or early 2027. The project hosts an estimated 1.2 million ounces of gold in Measured and Indicated resources per an NI 43-101 technical report dated May 1, 2026. The $8 million drill program, funded internally, is designed to update and refine the resource model, test additional targets that could expand the resource base, and provide the geotechnical, metallurgical, and hydrogeological data required for detailed mine planning. The Q3 2026 completion target for the drill program aligns with the production restart timeline — meaning preliminary drill results and the updated resource model will be available as Goldgroup advances the production decision. The timing is also directly relevant to the pending shareholder vote (July 2, 2026) on Goldgroup's planned acquisition of Gold Resource Corporation (NYSE: GORO) — a transaction that, if completed, would create a larger diversified gold producer combining the San Francisco asset with Gold Resource's Mexican and US operations. For retail investors evaluating small-cap gold producers with near-term production growth in Mexico, San Francisco's 1.2 Moz resource base with a defined restart path and an active 24,000-metre drill program at $4,100+ gold represents one of the clearest value creation catalysts available in the TSXV gold producer space in H2 2026.

headline: CHINA LOCKS DOWN MYANMAR'S HEAVY RARE EARTH CROWN JEWELS — XI MEETS JUNTA JUNE 16 AS KACHIN WAR THREATENS 94% OF GLOBAL HREE SUPPLY
snippet: Xi Jinping's June 16 state visit meeting with Myanmar junta leader Min Aung Hlaing in Beijing coincided with active military offensives in Myanmar's Kachin State targeting the heavy rare earth mining regions controlled by the Kachin Independence Army — a convergence that underscores China's direct strategic interest in securing physical access to the deposits that supply approximately 94% of China's heavy rare earth (HREE) imports. Myanmar's Chipwi-Pangwa township in northern Kachin State hosts some of the world's most concentrated deposits of dysprosium and terbium — the two heavy rare earth elements most critical for high-performance NdFeB permanent magnets used in EV motors, wind turbines, and defence guidance systems. The Kachin Independence Army holds operational control over the primary extraction zones and has disrupted ore export flows to Chinese processors on multiple occasions since October 2024; Chinese military advisors and the junta have been conducting offensives to recapture these areas through May-June 2026, with no confirmed resolution. The geopolitical significance extends well beyond China: because Myanmar is China's sole scalable source of heavy rare earth feedstock for its magnet manufacturing ecosystem, any sustained disruption to Kachin State production transmits directly to global HREE oxide prices and magnet supply chains within weeks — and to the Western supply security programmes (US Ex-Im Bank Project Vault, EU Critical Raw Materials Act procurement) that are funding alternative sources like Critical Metals' Tanbreez and American Rare Earths' Halleck Creek projects as strategic insurance. For retail investors in TSXV, ASX, and NASDAQ-listed rare earth developers, the Myanmar conflict is the single most important supply-side development in the HREE market and the primary justification for premium valuations of Western-jurisdiction dysprosium and terbium projects.

headline: GOLD SWOT: ASIAN ETFS KEEP BUYING WHAT WESTERN FUNDS ARE SELLING — PHYSICAL DEMAND FLOOR HOLDS EVEN AS FED SIGNALS RATE HIKE RISK
snippet: U.S. Global Investors' Gold SWOT for the week of June 15, 2026 identifies a critical bifurcation in gold ETF flows that explains why gold has not collapsed further despite the Federal Reserve's June hawkish pivot: Asian-based gold ETFs — primarily listed in China, Hong Kong, Japan, and India — have continued to add holdings at a pace consistent with Q1 2026's accumulation rate, even as US-listed and European-listed gold ETFs recorded net outflows in the weeks following the FOMC meeting. This East-West divergence in institutional positioning reflects the fundamental difference between Asian investors who view gold through the lens of currency debasement, geopolitical uncertainty, and savings preservation (demand that does not reverse on US rate signals), versus Western institutional investors who treat gold as a rate-sensitive macro trade that responds to Fed dot-plot signals. The Gold SWOT also flagged a weakening signal: the Turkish central bank sold approximately 130 tonnes of gold in June to defend the lira — a recurring pattern that has historically preceded periods of currency stress rather than marking gold's secular reversal. The broader picture for retail gold investors is that Asian physical and ETF demand is providing a structural floor under prices even during Western institutional corrections, and the current $4,100-$4,150 range represents the level at which Asian accumulated demand is absorbing Western speculative liquidation — setting up the asymmetric recovery pattern that characterises gold's post-correction phases when Western investor sentiment reengages.

headline: SPROTT URANIUM MID-YEAR: $85/LB SPOT, ACCELERATING UTILITY CONTRACTING, SUPPLY GAP DEFINES THE 2027-2030 BULL CASE
snippet: Sprott Asset Management's uranium mid-year 2026 analysis documents the structural conditions that support the long-term uranium bull market thesis even as spot prices consolidate near $85 per pound — well below the $107/lb peak reached in late 2025 but substantially above the $48-52/lb range at which NexGen's Rook I, Denison's Phoenix ISR, and Boss Energy's Honeymoon projects achieved their final investment decisions. The key market development through mid-year 2026 is the re-emergence of utility contracting activity after a prolonged period of under-contracting that concentrated utility demand into a compressed future buying window: with NexGen's Rook I, Denison's Phoenix, and Fission's Triple R now all under construction or advancing toward FID, the supply additions pipeline is becoming visible but not sufficient to prevent the mid-2020s supply gap that utility procurement officers are beginning to cover through long-term contracts. The Sprott analysis specifically highlights that the current $85/lb spot price — approximately 20% below the 2025 peak — reflects technical correction dynamics rather than any change in the fundamental supply-demand picture: utility demand through 2030 remains structurally under-contracted, the enrichment capacity required to increase utilisation factors is constrained, and the new mine construction timeline of 5-8 years from FID to production means that supply growth cannot exceed the rate set by projects that have already achieved FID. For retail uranium investors in TSXV and ASX-listed explorer-developers, the mid-year consolidation at $85/lb represents the same buy zone relative to the long-term utility contract price threshold that the 2023-2024 accumulation window represented at $55-65/lb.
